tagline: National banking association providing mortgage lending and deposit services
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI 'Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases' is the wow of Flagstar Bank because it represents a complex and subjective estimate of future loan losses, involving sophisticated models and judgments by expert auditors. It is a key indicator of the bank's financial risk management, designated as a critical audit matter by independent auditors.

kpis.short: Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases
kpis.name: Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans granted by the bank.
kpis.description: Represents the estimate of future losses on the loan portfolio, calculated using complex models and subjective judgments.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of credit risk management.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.explanation: All assets and rights owned by the bank.
kpis.description: Represents the total value of what the bank owns, including loans, securities, and cash.
kpis.signal: Size and scale of the bank.

kpis.name: Net loans
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans granted by the bank, less allowances for losses.
kpis.description: Represents the principal amount of funds lent to customers by the bank, net of the allowance for credit losses.
kpis.signal: Core lending activity of the bank.

kpis.name: Total deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of funds deposited by customers with the bank.
kpis.description: Represents the money entrusted to the bank by customers, serving as the basis for its lending operations.

kpis.name: Stockholders' equity
kpis.explanation: Net value of the bank belonging to shareholders.
kpis.description: Represents the difference between the bank's assets and liabilities, indicating residual value for owners.
kpis.signal: Financial strength and value for shareholders.
